sections.heading: MAJOR IN RELIGION AND THEOLOGY
lines: Completion of first-year requirements. 1.0 course from 1000 level Religious Studies courses (Religious Studies 1010F/G, Religious Studies 1015F/G and Religious Studies 1030A/B) is recommended.
1.0 course from: Greek 1103A/B, Greek 1104A/B or the former Religious Studies 1029, Religious Studies 2124F/G, Religious Studies 2310F/G, Religious Studies 2420A/B, Arabic 3260A/B, Hebrew 1040A/B.
1.0 additional course in Theological Studies and/or Religious Studies at the 2000 level or above.
3.0 additional courses in Theological Studies and/or Religious Studies at the 3000 level or above.
